run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the best array element after k single moves
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correctness
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that tracks maximum value and consecutive non-improving elements
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which returns the best element when times reaches threshold k
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the undefined f_filled function with a working implementation
